tours.name: Required Fields on a New Salary Rule

name_i18n.en_US: Required Fields on a New Salary Rule

tours.description: Learn what happens when you save a salary rule without its name, code and category, which payroll formulas rely on.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn what happens when you save a salary rule without its name, code and category, which payroll formulas rely on.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Salary rules are managed in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: Salary rules are managed in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the master data of the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the master data of the Payroll app.

steps.title: Rules
steps.description: Salary rules calculate the lines of a payslip.

description_i18n.en_US: Salary rules calculate the lines of a payslip.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to start a salary rule.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to start a salary rule.

steps.description: The form opens empty. Leave the required fields empty on purpose to see how Odoo protects the data.

description_i18n.en_US: The form opens empty. Leave the required fields empty on purpose to see how Odoo protects the data.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon without filling anything in.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon without filling anything in.

steps.description: Odoo checks the required fields when you save. A record with a required field left empty can never be stored.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo checks the required fields when you save. A record with a required field left empty can never be stored.

steps.title: Read the message
steps.content: Read the red message. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Read the red message. Click it to continue.

steps.description: The message names the missing fields, such as the rule name, its code and its category. The code is what formulas use to refer to the rule, so it is mandatory.

description_i18n.en_US: The message names the missing fields, such as the rule name, its code and its category. The code is what formulas use to refer to the rule, so it is mandatory.

steps.title: Discard
steps.content: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

steps.description: Nothing was stored. The red outline on the field shows what is missing. Fill it in and save again to create a real salary rule.

description_i18n.en_US: Nothing was stored. The red outline on the field shows what is missing. Fill it in and save again to create a real salary rule.
